newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers 200 MW peak firm power for Friday.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers 200 MW peak firm power for Friday.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered 200 megawatts (MW) of peak firm power for Friday delivery, the agency said Thursday.
BPA last offered pre-scheduled power on Monday, when deals were scheduled through Thursday due to a three-day training seminar.
For Friday, BPA's price for peak firm power was $15.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) for Northwest deliveries and $18.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) deliveries.
BPA also continued to offer an unlimited volume of light-load firm power for both days at $9.00 for all deliveries.
BPA prices for non-firm power during hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PDT were also unchanged at $7.00 for Northwest and $8.00 at COB.
Non-firm power during hours ending 0600, 0700 and 2300 PDT was unchanged at $10.00.
